svg.desc: Each CONOPS mode with its concern, hazards and requirements
svg.text: Figure 6 · Operating modes and what rests on each
The 10 modes of the CONOPS with their safety concern, the hazards recorded as occurring in each and the requirements those
hazards trace to. 10 of 10 modes carry at least one hazard.
Generated by tools/figures/concept_readme.py from ConceptOperations.sysml, CONOPS.md, safety/hazards/ and requirements/. Concept stage: hazards and requirements are drafts, risk is preliminary.

g.text: Terms: CONOPS = concept of operations · HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · MOD-nnn = operating mode from the CONOPS (MOD-01 to MOD-10) · UAV = uncrewed aerial
